The criteria for the allocation of public funds shall no longer be according to the number of votes won in the general election by a political party. The new criteria shall be the proportion of seats won by a political party in the Assembly. Political parties shall receive an annual amount of 500.000 ren per Member of Assembly.

(This results in a doubling of the USP election budget and a slight increase in the other parties in the Assembly while effectively removing all funding from parties that are below the 10% election threshold.)
target: 公共資金的分配標準將不再根據政黨在大選中獲得的選票數量而定。新的標準將是政黨在議會中獲得的席位比例。政黨每位議會議員每年將獲得50萬倫的資金。
